notes: Synthetic job descriptions for fictional companies. Each one is written for this evaluation set and modelled on the structure and typical requirements of the public postings listed in modeled_on; none is a copy. requirements is the reviewed answer key for JD analysis.

jds.title: Software Engineer, New Grad (2027 Start)
traps: language alternatives: Python, Java, or C++ is one requirement, not three
jds.text:
Software Engineer, New Grad (2027 Start)
Lumenstack, Austin TX (hybrid)

Lumenstack builds data infrastructure used by thousands of analytics teams. New grads join a cohort and are placed on backend, full-stack, or infrastructure teams with a dedicated mentor.

What you'll do
- Build features and improve the architecture of the Lumenstack platform
- Own work through design, implementation, testing, and operating in production
- Write reliable, well-tested code and take part in code reviews

What we look for
- Graduating between December 2026 and August 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related subject
- Implementation skills in a general-purpose language such as Python, Java, or C++
- Knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented programming
- Experience working on a software project with others, through internships, coursework, or open source

Nice to have
- Experience with a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Familiarity with SQL databases
- Prior software engineering internship

requirements.text: Degree in CS, Engineering, or related subject, graduating Dec 2026 - Aug 2027
Implementation skills in Python, Java, or C++
Algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented programming
Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

jds.title: Junior Backend Engineer (Python)
jds.text:
Junior Backend Engineer (Python)
Fernwave, Remote (UK/EU time zones)

Fernwave runs a personalisation platform for online retailers. You will write production backend code from your first week, with senior engineers to learn from.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain Python services, REST APIs, and background workers
- Work with our database and cache layers
- Write tests and contribute to code reviews
- Join the on-call rotation as you ramp up, with support

Requirements
- 0-2 years of Python backend experience (strong internships or projects count)
- Solid Python fundamentals
- Working knowledge of SQL and REST API design
- Experience writing automated tests
- Comfortable with Git

Nice to have
- FastAPI or Django
- Docker
- Redis or another cache
- Kafka or another message queue
- AWS

requirements.text: 0-2 years Python backend experience (internships or projects count)

jds.title: Backend Engineer, Platform
jds.text:
Backend Engineer, Platform
Harbourline, Hamburg (hybrid, 2-3 days on site)

Harbourline builds an energy-trading platform with real-time APIs. Our platform squad owns the services and data pipelines behind it.

You will
- Design, build, and operate Python services and REST APIs
- Improve PostgreSQL schemas and query performance
- Ship through CI/CD pipelines to AWS
- Take part in on-call and incident reviews

You have
- 2-4 years of professional backend development experience
- Strong Python, with Django or FastAPI
- PostgreSQL, including query optimisation
- Docker and CI/CD pipelines
- AWS (ECS, Lambda, or similar)

Bonus
- Kubernetes
- Terraform
- Observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Sentry
- Celery or another task queue

Senior Backend Engineer, Distributed Systems
Corvid Labs, Remote (US)

Corvid Labs processes billions of telemetry events per day for industrial customers. We are hiring a senior engineer to lead the design of our next-generation ingestion pipeline.

What you'll do
- Lead design and delivery of high-throughput, fault-tolerant services
- Set technical direction for a team of five engineers and mentor less experienced colleagues
- Own reliability: SLOs, incident response, and capacity planning

What you bring
- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building distributed systems in production
- Strong Go or Java
- Production experience with Kafka or a comparable event-streaming platform
- Kubernetes in production
- A track record of mentoring engineers and leading technical projects

Nice to have
- Experience with time-series databases
- Terraform

Quillpay, Berlin (hybrid)

jds.text:
Embedded Software Engineer I
Halcyon Devices, Columbus OH (on site)

Halcyon designs connected sensors for commercial buildings. You'll be paired with experienced engineers and own pieces of shipping firmware.

Required qualifications
- Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, completed or expected within the year
- 0-2 years of experience; internships, research, capstone, or personal projects with embedded or systems software count
- Proficiency in C and/or C++
- Experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or embedded Linux
- Exposure to microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, Arduino) and peripherals such as UART, SPI, or I2C
- Comfortable on the Linux command line
- Git

Preferred
- Python for test automation
- Reading circuit schematics
- Must be able to work on site in Columbus, OH
